items.label: No-Contact Thermometer
items.value: This touchless thermometer provides contactless accurate temperature reading that helps you avoid cross infections. No need to clean the thermometer after every use

items.label: Advanced Technologies for Excellent Performance
items.value: We provide Ultra Sensitive sensors and the latest smart chip with the optimized algorithm to deliver reliable readings and ensure excellent performance. Just faster, more reliable, precise, and hygienic

items.label: Easy to Use
items.value: Innovative designs and simple, easy-to-use one-button control make our thermometers ideal for use with babies, children, adults, and the elderly

items.label: Fever Alarm
items.value: There are 3 colors displayed on the LCD screen for different temperature levels. A clear large LCD Screen Display allows you to read day and night easily. ℉ and ℃ are easily switchable

items.label: 35 Set Memory Recalls
items.value: Our baby thermometer is equipped with an internal memory that can store up to 35 sets of data readings, allowing you to track the historical temperature changes for you and your family

items.label: Possible reasons for not working
items.value: 1) battery incorrectly installed or drained; 2) physical damage to the device;3) incorrect operation (not following the quick start guide); 4) or potential electronic malfunction. Contact support for 24/7 troubleshooting assistance.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Non-Contact, High Accuracy, Fast Reading System, Large Display,Auto Off,℉/ ℃

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1* Thermometer, 2* AAA Battery, 1* Manual, 1* Quick Start Guide
